survivalists_magicks:components/warmup.d: The Amount of Delay between casting and execution
Determines the strength of the heat effect
If set to 1, you won't be able to heat yourself up to the point of a heatstroke
survivalists_magicks:components/cooldown: The Amount of Delay between casting and execution
Determines the strength of the cooling effect
If set to 1, you won't be able to overcool yourself to the point of contracting frostbite
